packages_desc: si18n.js 2.0 is completely rewritten in TypeScript and structured into dedicated packages for every use case:

browser.title: si18n.js (Browser)
browser.desc: Full browser client. Automatic HTML attribute translations (data-si18n-*), automated toggler buttons and <select> pickers, LTR/RTL switching, URL & browser language detection, and localStorage persistence.

core.title: si18n.js/core (Universal Engine)
core.desc: Platform-agnostic and ultra-lightweight translation core with zero DOM dependencies. Runs in any JS runtime (Browser, Node.js, Deno, Bun, React Native, Edge). Pluggable dependencies and custom storage adapters (StorageAdapter).

node.title: si18n.js/node (Node.js)
node.desc: Optimized Node.js implementation. Local filesystem file loading via node:fs/promises, automatic OS language detection (LC_ALL, LANG, etc.), and built-in memory or process.env storage adapters.

react.title: si18n.js/react (React Client)
react.desc: Context provider <Si18nProvider> and useTranslation() hook. Synchronous, tear-free rendering powered by useSyncExternalStore. Exposes t, locale, locales, setLocale, isReady and error.

react_server.title: si18n.js/react/server (React Server / RSC)
react_server.desc: Async createServerTranslator() translator for React Server Components (Next.js App Router), SSR and server rendering pipelines. Zero DOM and lightning-fast execution.

params.locales: Object containing your language translations. Required only if path or localeLoader is not defined.
params.path: Access path to the directory containing your translation JSON files. Files will be loaded automatically according to the active language (the fallback language will always be loaded). Priority over the locales option. Required only if locales is not defined. e.g.: ./locales.
params.localeLoader: Custom async loader function (locale) => Promise<object> to load locale messages dynamically. Ideal for bundler code-splitting or server-side loaders.
params.availableLocales: List containing the names of available languages as defined in the translation files. Required only if path is defined.
params.lang: Active language to use. If omitted, si18n.js detects language from URL, storage, or environment (browser / system variables). If not set, the fallbackLang option becomes required.
params.fallbackLang: Fallback language. The language to use when the requested language or a requested string in a non-fully translated language is missing. If omitted, it falls back to the value of lang.
params.activeClass: CSS class to add to the active button for the current language. Used with togglersSelector.
params.togglersSelector: CSS selector for toggler elements. si18n.js automatically binds click listeners. Elements must have the data-lang="XX" attribute.
params.isTogglerSelect: Set to true if the toggler selector targets a <select> element. Unavailable options are automatically disabled.
params.saveLang: Whether to save the language in persistent storage (localStorage for browser, memory or process.env for Node.js).
params.saveAs: Key name for persistent storage and URL parameter (Default: 'lang').
params.reloadPage: If set to true, the page will automatically refresh after changing language.
params.translate:
Callback function called to apply manual translations.
Note: For browsers, the <html> tag automatically receives lang and dir attributes.
params.onLocaleChanged: Central callback triggered on locale changes (on init and setLocale). Receives (locale, instance).
params.dependencies: Pluggable dependency injection object for Si18nCore and Si18nNode: storage (custom StorageAdapter), detectLanguage, getLanguageFromUrl, createPathLocaleLoader, reload, logError.

methods.constructor: Instantiates the si18n object. Accepts initial options and an optional dependencies object.
methods.init: Recommended - Asynchronously initializes the si18n object with given options. Returns a Promise<void>.
methods.setLocale: Sets the active language, loads translation data if needed, and applies changes. Returns a Promise<void>.
methods.getLocales: Returns a copy of all available languages (e.g.: ['fr', 'en']).
methods.t: Returns the translation string for the given key (supports dot notation: site.nav.link). Accepts an optional replacement object %{key}.
methods.subscribe: Subscribes to locale changes and returns an unsubscribe function () => void.
methods.isInitialized: Returns true if the instance is initialized, otherwise false.
methods.getJSON: Static async method fetching JSON from a URL (browser via fetch) or file path (Node.js via fs). Returns Promise<T> or passes result to optional callback.
methods.toJSON: Returns a serialized snapshot of the instance configuration options.
methods.createMemoryStorage: Creates an in-memory volatile storage adapter (StorageAdapter) based on a Map.
methods.createProcessEnvStorage: Creates a storage adapter persisting active locale in process.env[saveAs].
methods.createServerTranslator: Async function creating a translator { t, locale, locales, i18n } for React Server Components (RSC / Next.js / SSR).
methods.provider: Context component <Si18nProvider> synchronizing locale changes tear-free via useSyncExternalStore.
methods.useTranslation: React hook returning { t, locale, locales, setLocale, isReady, error, i18n }.

others.valuesReplacementDesc: Besides simple text replacements, si18n.js can insert dynamic values into placeholders with %{name} or %{0} syntax. Simply pass a key-value object as the second argument to t():

autoDetect.autoDetectionDesc: In browser environments, si18n.js automatically inspects and translates elements bearing these attributes:
autoDetect.autoSetLangAndDir: The lang and dir attributes of the <html> tag are set automatically. Set "rtl": true in your locale file to activate RTL direction automatically. Default: ltr.
autoDetect.noContentDesc: When data-si18n-default="false" is set, the translation is not inserted into the element's textContent. Useful when only translating HTML attributes (title, placeholder, alt, etc.).
autoDetect.cdnDesc: You can also use si18n.js from a CDN. Different builds are distributed depending on your import style:
autoDetect.cdnClassicDesc: Classic global script (non-module) which sets the global class window.Si18n.
autoDetect.cdnEs6Desc: Untranspiled ES6 source modules. Recommended if your own bundler handles transpiling node_modules.
autoDetect.attrDescType: The following attributes are boolean flags ("true" or "false") targeting specific element properties:
autoDetect.attrDesc:
• data-si18n: translation key to apply (e.g. "site.title").
  • data-si18n-default: if set to "false", does not overwrite the element's text content.
  • data-si18n-html: if set to "true", injects the translated string as HTML (innerHTML). Default: false.
  • data-si18n-placeholder: translates the placeholder attribute of <input> and <textarea> elements.
  • data-si18n-alt: translates the alt attribute of <img> elements for accessibility.
  • data-si18n-title: translates the element's native tooltip title attribute.
  • data-si18n-aria-label: translates the aria-label attribute for screen readers.
  • data-si18n-label: translates the label attribute of tags like <optgroup>.
  • data-si18n-value: translates the value attribute of tags like <option> or <input>.
  • data-si18n-content: translates the content attribute of tags like <meta> (SEO / prerendering).
